svg.text: Carved wanza wood with two Walia ibex heads. Third-angle projection. 1 p = 100 px (1 px = 0.5 mm) unless marked.
Player A sits at the bottom edge (+z),
player B at the top edge.
Each store is on its owner's right:
Cup Ø: section C–C. Store Ø: B–B.
cups and stores hidden (dashed) · band motif: sheet 3
player A side ← → player B side
1.5 (0.03) clear between neck flare and store
necks broken off above 20 (0.4) · head and board are one carving
(across, through holes 2 and 9; player A on the left)
Cup and store rims R 1.5 (0.03). Neck foot blends into the top with R 7.5 (0.15).
Hole numbers are the game's. Head and horns: sheet 2. Carved band: sheet 3.
Plan, elevations and B–B 1 p = 100 px; C–C and foot 1 p = 200 px
